summary: Repaired both reviewer findings in the bounded 37-case native aperture-release exploration. Bridge geometry now uses the maximum aperture-local X/Y span, preserving sustained distinct-rib contact as the physical support evidence and admitting yaw=90° bridges. The no_support label now additionally requires the existing settling-speed bound; moving unsupported cases remain unstable_support. Added auditable in-plane span measurements to child reports and traces. Both scripts pass Python static compilation. Native GPU execution remains for the trusted controller; no qualification is claimed.
